title: Coding Challenge 5: REST API (Cat Facts)
description:
Learn how to interact with a public REST API in JavaScript using fetch() and async/await. In this challenge, you will connect to the free, public Cat Facts API (https://catfact.ninja) to retrieve trivia about cats, work with query parameters, and parse JSON responses.

You need to implement three asynchronous functions:
1. getRandomCatFact(): Makes a GET request to 'https://catfact.ninja/fact' and returns the fact string (data.fact).
2. getShortCatFact(maxLength): Makes a GET request to 'https://catfact.ninja/fact?max_length=[maxLength]' and returns the fact string whose length is less than or equal to maxLength.
3. getCatFacts(count): Makes a GET request to 'https://catfact.ninja/facts?limit=[count]' and returns an array containing just the fact strings extracted from the response data array.
requirements: Implement 'getRandomCatFact()' as an async function that fetches from 'https://catfact.ninja/fact'
'getRandomCatFact()' must parse the response JSON and return the 'fact' string
Implement 'getShortCatFact(maxLength)' as an async function accepting a maximum length number
'getShortCatFact(maxLength)' must fetch with '?max_length=[maxLength]' and return a fact string with length <= maxLength
Implement 'getCatFacts(count)' as an async function accepting a count number
'getCatFacts(count)' must fetch with '?limit=[count]' and return an array of count fact strings extracted from data.data
hints: Use 'const response = await fetch(url);' and 'const data = await response.json();' inside async functions
For simple GET requests, do not pass custom headers or mode: 'no-cors'. Standard fetch('https://catfact.ninja/fact') works out of the box
Check 'if (!response.ok)' to handle possible HTTP or rate-limit errors
For getRandomCatFact, return 'data.fact' (a string), not the entire object
For getShortCatFact(maxLength), use template literals: `https://catfact.ninja/fact?max_length=${maxLength}` and return 'data.fact'
For getCatFacts(count), the API returns an object containing a 'data' array. Use data.data.map(item => item.fact) to return an array of strings

tests.name: getRandomCatFact is an async function
tests.test: function() { try { if (typeof getRandomCatFact !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getRandomCatFact function does not exist' }; } const res = getRandomCatFact(); if (!res || typeof res.then !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getRandomCatFact must return a Promise (mark it async)' }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: e.message }; } }

tests.name: getRandomCatFact fetches a valid cat fact string
tests.test: async function() { try { if (typeof getRandomCatFact !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getRandomCatFact is not defined' }; } const fact = await getRandomCatFact(); if (typeof fact !== 'string' || fact.trim().length === 0) { if (typeof fact === 'object' && fact !== null) { if (fact.fact) { return { success: false, message: 'You returned the whole response object instead of the fact string. Return data.fact!' }; } return { success: false, message: 'Received an object ' + JSON.stringify(fact) + ' instead of a fact string. Ensure you awaited response.json() and returned data.fact.' }; } return { success: false, message: 'Expected a non-empty string for fact, got: ' + JSON.stringify(fact) }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: 'Failed fetching cat fact: ' + e.message }; } }
tests.successMessage: Successfully fetched random cat fact from API ✓

tests.name: getShortCatFact is an async function
tests.test: function() { try { if (typeof getShortCatFact !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getShortCatFact function does not exist' }; } const res = getShortCatFact(100); if (!res || typeof res.then !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getShortCatFact must return a Promise (mark it async)' }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: e.message }; } }

tests.name: getShortCatFact respects maxLength parameter
tests.test: async function() { try { if (typeof getShortCatFact !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getShortCatFact is not defined' }; } const maxLen = 80; const fact = await getShortCatFact(maxLen); if (typeof fact !== 'string' || fact.trim().length === 0) { if (typeof fact === 'object' && fact !== null && fact.fact) { return { success: false, message: 'You returned the whole object instead of the fact string. Return data.fact!' }; } return { success: false, message: 'Expected a non-empty string, got: ' + JSON.stringify(fact) }; } if (fact.length > maxLen) { return { success: false, message: 'Expected fact length <= ' + maxLen + ', but received ' + fact.length + ' characters: "' + fact + '"' }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: 'Error in getShortCatFact: ' + e.message }; } }
tests.successMessage: getShortCatFact correctly respects maxLength query parameter ✓

tests.name: getCatFacts is an async function
tests.test: function() { try { if (typeof getCatFacts !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getCatFacts function does not exist' }; } const res = getCatFacts(2); if (!res || typeof res.then !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getCatFacts must return a Promise (mark it async)' }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: e.message }; } }

tests.name: getCatFacts(3) returns an array of 3 fact strings
tests.test: async function() { try { if (typeof getCatFacts !== 'function') { return { success: false, message: 'getCatFacts is not defined' }; } const facts = await getCatFacts(3); if (!Array.isArray(facts)) { return { success: false, message: 'Expected getCatFacts to return an Array, got ' + typeof facts }; } if (facts.length !== 3) { return { success: false, message: 'Expected exactly 3 facts, got array of length ' + facts.length }; } const allStrings = facts.every(item => typeof item === 'string' && item.trim().length > 0); if (!allStrings) { return { success: false, message: 'Every element in the array must be a non-empty fact string. Got: ' + JSON.stringify(facts) }; } return { success: true }; } catch(e) { return { success: false, message: 'Error in getCatFacts: ' + e.message }; } }
tests.successMessage: getCatFacts correctly fetches and maps multiple cat facts ✓
